one_line_description: Online payment infrastructure and APIs for global payments
auth_methods_evidence: The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests. You can view and manage your API keys in the Stripe Dashboard. Test mode secret keys start with sk_test_ and have unrestricted access to their sandboxes. In live mode, you configure a restricted API key (starts with rk_live_) with specific API permissions.
self_serve_evidence: You can view and manage your API keys in the Stripe Dashboard. Test mode secret keys start with sk_test_ and have unrestricted access to their sandboxes.
buildability_rationale: Self-serve with free tier, comprehensive API documentation, broad API surface, multiple auth methods, and Composio support.
agent_notes: Stripe offers a comprehensive API with both API key and OAuth2 authentication methods. The documentation is thorough and accessible, with a clear self-serve onboarding process. The API is REST-based with webhook support, and Composio provides extensive tooling integration.
